description: This file defines an internal interface 'IClusterConnectionStatusListener' for listeners that need to respond to connection status changes in an Orleans cluster, including gateway count changes and connection loss notifications.

classes.name: IClusterConnectionStatusListener
classes.description: An internal interface for observing changes in cluster connection status, including gateway count updates and connection loss notifications.

methods.name: NotifyGatewayCountChanged
methods.description: Method to notify that the number of connected gateways has changed.

methods.name: NotifyClusterConnectionLost
methods.description: Method to notify that the connection to the cluster has been lost.
